mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
